description:
A well-presented and fully furnished two-bedroom student flat situated in the highly sought-after Kingsdown area of Bristol. Ideally positioned within walking distance of Bristol University, the city centre, and a wide range of local amenities, this property offers comfortable and convenient student living in one of Bristol's most popular locations.

The flat comprises two good-sized bedrooms, a bright and welcoming living area, a fitted kitchen with essential appliances, and a bathroom. Offered fully furnished throughout, the property is ready for students to move straight into and enjoy.

Kingsdown is renowned for its attractive Georgian streets, vibrant atmosphere, and excellent access to both the university and Bristol's extensive shops, cafés, restaurants, and transport links.

Key Features:

Fully furnished throughout

Two spacious bedrooms

Popular Kingsdown location

Ideal for Bristol University students

Bright and comfortable living space

Fitted kitchen with appliances

Walking distance to the city centre

Close to shops, cafés, and local amenities

Excellent public transport links

Available for the upcoming academic year

Early viewing is highly recommended to secure this fantastic student property.
